summary: Vox Royalty Corp., a NASDAQ/TSX-listed mining royalty company, filed a 6-K reporting completion by its wholly owned subsidiary Vox Royalty Australia Pty Ltd of three Australian royalty acquisitions: the White Dam Gold Royalty (South Australia), Kalman Copper Royalty (Queensland), and Sylvania Royalty (Western Australia), previously announced August 20 and September 2, 2026. Aggregate cash consideration was A$8.4 million (approximately US$6 million), funded from cash on hand. All conditions precedent were satisfied, including waiver by operator Greenmount Resources, a Capricorn Metals subsidiary, of its right of first refusal over Sylvania. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. Watch integration and royalty revenue timing.
